title: Setup user page: add an "AI Assistants" tab that shows and revokes the assistants a person authorized
body:
domain:ui#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibxW6qraU2Z3mwupUGp

Filing gate: ③ the maintainer's order that names this work: #30894 (「都同意，立卡」, 2026-11-06). Its Expected says "An administrator can see and revoke them for a person they manage". ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade and the lane. Suggested grade: p1 (#30894's grade; this is the half that closes it).

**Business reason.** A person who lost a laptop with Claude Desktop on it may not be able to sign in and withdraw it themselves, and an administrator handling a departure or role change needs to see and end what acts as that person. The server doors exist (#31048, PR #31073) and the console widget is built (PR #31084), but no page shows it, so an administrator still cannot find it.

**Reader.** The lane that owns `packages/platform-objects` page metadata (`domain:server`), then the `domain:ui` seat holding #30894.

**Dedupe.** `sys-user.page.ts tab` (only the page's own history), `authorized-assistants` (#30918, #31048, both closed, #30894 open), `admin revoke assistant user page` (none). **New.**

## What exists

- `GET /api/v1/auth/admin/authorized-clients?userId=` and `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/authorized-clients/withdraw` `{ userId, id }`, platform-admin gated (#30946, #31073); client `oauth.authorizedClients.listForUser` / `withdrawForUser`.
- PR #31084 (`Part of #30894`) registers the SDUI widget `mcp:authorized-assistants` in `@object-ui/app-shell`. It takes no props and reads the bound record through `useRecordContext()`. That record must be a `sys_user` with an id; anywhere else it renders nothing. It lists that person's assistants with a confirm-first Revoke. A caller who is not a platform admin sees the server's 403 as a failed read.
- `packages/platform-objects/src/pages/sys-user.page.ts` is `kind: 'full'` and owns a curated `page:tabs` strip (Details, Positions, Permission Sets, Business Units, Sessions, OAuth Apps, API Keys, Preferences, Security). The console has no ui-side door to add a tab there.

## Wanted

- [ ] One `page:tabs` item in `sys-user.page.ts`, "AI Assistants" (with the page's inline label locales), whose body is `{ type: 'mcp:authorized-assistants', properties: {} }`.
- [ ] Whether the tab is shown only to a platform administrator, and how, is this lane's call. The server refuses anyone else either way.
- [ ] Lands after PR #31084 (the widget must be registered before a page names it). This card's PR says `Fixes #30894`.

Related: #30894, #31048 (PR #31073), PR #31084, #30918 (PR #30946).
